n: const APP_VERSION="v23";(()=>{const run=()=>{const root=document.querySelector("#app")||document.body;const hs=[...root.querySelectorAll("h1,h2,h3,h4,[role=heading]")].filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length);const norm=s=>(s||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim().toLowerCase();const sales=hs.some(e=>/laporan\s+penjualan/.test(norm(e.textContent)));const pnl=hs.some(e=>/laporan\s+laba\s+rugi/.test(norm(e.textContent)));if(!sales||pnl)return;for(const e of [...root.querySelectorAll("*")]){if(!e.getClientRects().length||e.children.length>3)continue;const t=norm(e.innerText||e.textContent);if(!/(omset|omzet|pendapatan)/i.test(t)||t.length>180)continue;let p=e;for(let i=0;i<7&&p.parentElement&&p.parentElement!==root;i++){const q=p.parentElement;if(q.matches("section,article,.card,[class*=card],[class*=stat],[class*=metric],[class*=summary],[class*=report]")){p=q;break;}p=q;}if(p&&p!==root){p.style.setProperty("display","none","important");p.setAttribute("data-omset-hidden","v23");}}};new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});run();})();
